ঝড়টি ছিল অন্ধকার আর ভয়জাগানিয়া,
মাথার ওপর ঘনিয়ে উঠেছিল কালো মেঘ।
আমার চারদিকে বিদ্যুৎ ঝলসে উঠল,
ভয় আমাকে আঁকড়ে ধরে আতঙ্কে ভরিয়ে দিল।

বজ্রধ্বনি গড়িয়ে আনল অশুভ পূর্বাভাস।
আমার হৃদয় ভারী আর অবশ লাগছিল।
চারদিকে ঝড় তাণ্ডব চালাচ্ছিল,
ভেতরের অস্থিরতা আমাকে নির্বাক করে দিল।

বিপদ শুধু আমাকে ঘিরেই ছিল না,
ভেতরের বিপদও ছিল ঠিক ততটাই বাস্তব।
ভবিষ্যতের দিকে তাকিয়ে আমি কাঁপছিলাম,
এরপর কীভাবে শুরু করব, তা না জেনে।

কুয়াশার ওপারে কী ছিল?
বাতাস আমার কানে শিস দিচ্ছিল।
নানা প্রশ্ন তুলে, পা হড়কে দিয়ে,
আর ভয়ে আমাকে ভারাক্রান্ত করে।

এই ঝড় পথের সব চিহ্ন মুছে দিয়েছিল,
যে পথ একসময় ভেবেছিলাম দেখতে পাচ্ছি।
এখন আমার চোখে চেনা সবকিছুই হারিয়ে গেছে,
প্রতিটি পদক্ষেপ পড়ছিল দ্বিধায়।

নিজের সাধ্যের শেষ প্রান্তে এসে ভয়ে চিৎকার করে উঠলাম...
"প্রভু, আমার কাছে এসো! দেরি কোরো না, হে আমার রাজা!"
ভারী নীরবতা নেমে এল, নিজেকে লাগল সম্পূর্ণ একা,
শুধু আশাকেই আঁকড়ে রইলাম।

তারপর এক শান্ত, অথচ দৃঢ় কণ্ঠ আমার কানে বলল,
"আমার প্রিয় সন্তান, ওপরে তাকাও।"
এমন অনুরোধ কেন? যখন আমি ডুবে আছি
এমন কুয়াশায়, যা কিছুতেই কাটতে চায় না।

আশা বুকে নিয়ে আমি চোখ তুললাম,
চারপাশের কালো মেঘে কাঁপছিলাম।
তবু তাকিয়ে আরও কিছু দেখতে পেলাম,
আকাশে এক অমূল্য সম্পদ খুঁজে পেলাম।

সব অন্ধকার আর ভয়জাগানিয়া মেঘের মাঝে,
সেখানে ছিল তা! আলোর এক ফাঁক!
মনোহর রঙে রংধনু জ্বলজ্বল করছিল,
এই অন্ধকার রাতে এক আলোকবর্তিকা।

"আমার সন্তান, ভয় কোরো না, তুমি কখনো একা ছিলে না।
এক মুহূর্তের জন্যও আমি তোমার পাশ ছেড়ে যাইনি।
পথ অস্পষ্ট, আর সহ্য করার আছে অনেক কিছু,
তবু সন্দেহ কোরো না, আমার মধ্যে তুমি আশ্রয় পাবে।"

"হ্যাঁ, আপাতত তুমি পরীক্ষার মধ্য দিয়ে চলছ,
ভয় ভেতরে-বাইরে দুদিকেই হুমকি দিচ্ছে।
ভাবছ, প্রশ্ন করছ, এরপর কী করতে হবে,
বিপদগুলো যেন উপহাস করে অবজ্ঞা জানায়।"

"কিন্তু এখানে আমি আমার রংধনু স্থাপন করেছি,
সমস্ত অন্ধকার আর ভয়ের মাঝেও,
তুমি দেখতে পারো, আমার প্রতিশ্রুতি নিশ্চিত।
আমি কখনো ত্যাগ করব না, বরং সর্বদা কাছে থাকব।"

"এই প্রতিশ্রুতির ওপর চোখ রাখলে,
আমার আলো তোমাকে পথ দেখাবে।
চারপাশের ভয় আর বিপদ
তখন দূরেই থাকবে।"

"এই প্রতিশ্রুতি তোমার কাছে খুলে দিতে পারে
ঝড়ের মাঝে লুকিয়ে থাকা রহস্যগুলোও।
কারণ আমার শক্তি ও ক্ষমতা প্রকাশ পায়,
যখন এই রহস্যগুলো আমার ইচ্ছার সঙ্গে মেলে।"

"তাই, আমার সন্তান, রংধনুর দিকে গভীরভাবে তাকিয়ে থাকো।
সে যে বার্তা নিয়ে আসে, তা নিয়ে ভাবো।
তোমার চারপাশের সবকিছু রুষ্ট আর উত্তাল হলেও,
মনে রেখো, সে যে প্রতিশ্রুতির গান গায়।"

~আদ্রিয়ানা ফ্যান্টনের লেখা

Pride is something that everyone must deal with. It is something that naturally tends to come into our lives and stay. Like many other things, it is very deceitful, because it is commonly accepted by the world in which we live. People today are proud of being proud. Americans are proud of their country, their jobs, their children, their lawns, their sports teams, their vehicles, their ambitions, their goals, their looks, their friends, their homes, and the list could go on. If we think about it, the carnal man is proud of just about anything. People stand and proclaim they are proud and boast of their great accomplishments. People look at something someone has done and proclaim to the doer, “You should be proud of yourself!”

There is one problem; God hates pride! God actually despises the proud. In Psalms, it says that God will cut off …the tongue that speaketh proud things –Psalm 12:3. And in Job it says He will …behold every one that is proud, and abase [put down or make low] him –Job 40:11. Psalms 40:4 says He will not respect the proud and in Psalm 119: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments –Psalm 119:21. In Proverbs, we read that: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud… –Proverbs 15:25, and that Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD… –Proverbs 16:5. In Malachi, it says that …behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud… –Malachi 4:1. Finally, James states that …God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble –James 4:6.

As we can see, the Bible is very clear on pride, and the people who are proud. There is no room for pride in our hearts or lives. So, what do we do with this? Are we proud? Do we boast as the world does?

I would like to call attention to a hidden form of pride that can slip into our lives, sometimes unnoticed. We will call it false humility. If we have a false humility, would it not actually be a form of pride?

Let us look first at Law and Grace. Someone that is under the law does not desire to do what he must do, but rather, he does it because of the law. For example, the law states that we should not kill, yet (according to the law) we are allowed to be angry. Someone can hate another and even desire to kill him, but if they resist the temptation to kill, they have indeed kept the law. Many people today who claim to be Christians, are actually under the law. They do all that they do because of a law, or an order from their authority. We can see this clearly when people push the law, doing the least that is required, but still technically keeping the law.

The head covering is a good example. A woman who desires to cover her head because of what the Bible teaches, will indeed cover her head. She does not need to be reminded to do it or be admonished for doing it half-heartedly. On the other hand, there are Christians that cover their heads; however, the actual covering continues to get smaller, and less noticeable. Some even put it all the way on the back of the head and color it the same as their hair, trying to keep it from being noticed by the uncovered public. This clearly reveals the heart; they are simply complying with the law.

This type of thinking can go for many things. One more would be adornment. The bible says that the adornment should not be outward. Many Christians will not adorn themselves with flashy eye-catching things, however there are no standards about adorning homes, vehicles, and such like. So, a plain, unadorned person gets out of their adorned vehicle and walks into their very adorned home. This shows where the heart is—under the law.

Now let us look at grace. It is the power of God in the life of a human being. It causes one to actually love their enemies, to do good to those who mistreat them. It causes one to love their God with all their heart and obey God’s commands because of a passionate love for Him. The law is no longer needed because the heart is new; it desires to live for God. When someone does evil to you, you do not think about getting even. In fact, you do not even get angry. You are a new creature and because of this power—grace from God—you love him that has done you wrong. Forgiving is not a problem; helping others is natural. You are not your own and you desire to be all you can be for your Savior who died for you.

What does this have to do with pride or humility?

The Bible says that …the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ –John 1:17. It does not take God’s Spirit in our lives for us to obey the law—we can do that on our own. Therefore, we can become proud by doing things for God because WE did them. When we did not allow our anger to spew out when disagreeing with a neighbor, we think well of ourselves, and we can become proud. However, when we actually love our neighbor that has a problem with us, we cannot become proud because it was grace; it was the power of God that caused this, not ourselves. Therefore, we marvel at God and his abundant grace.

It would be foolish for someone to be proud of something that God clearly did! If Lazarus walked around boasting of himself for being raised from the dead, people would question his sanity, saying, “You did nothing! It was Jesus that did everything.”

I’m not trying to say that the Christian does nothing. No, we must humbly obey the commandments of God and walk in His ways. However, I am saying that we cannot boast in ourselves because it is God that enables us to obey His commandments.

Let us look at the popular story of David and Goliath. David went to the army to take provisions to his brothers who were fighting there. As he approached, he marveled at what he saw, a large man challenging his people! David seemed a bit shocked, and aggrieved as he asked, …who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God? –1 Samuel 17:26.

What does David’s oldest brother Eliab say to him? “I know thy pride.”

Eliab thought the attitude of David was prideful, and we can see why. A ruddy youth walks up from tending sheep and wonders why someone is not taking care of this large man. It sounds a bit off. But what was David thinking? He was only thinking about what God could, and most likely, wanted to do! He did not think for a moment that he himself could do anything in this situation.

He is then brought before King Saul: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth –1 Samuel 17:33.

David responded, … Thy servant kept his father’s sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him. Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God –1 Samuel 17:34-36.

David here is super confident, but why?! David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine… –1 Samuel 17:37.

Clearly his confidence is because the Lord is fighting for him. David was not concerned that he was “but a youth” and he did not understand why people questioned him. He was only thinking about what God was going to do! However, Eliab saw David’s confidence as pride. Possibly God had not worked in Eliab’s life. Maybe he did not know of the power of God; therefore, to him it looked like foolish pride.

And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail. And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him –1 Samuel 17:38-39.

So, David chose to not wear the armor; it would only have been a hindrance. Rather, he chose some stones then he ran out to fight the giant. Of course, the giant also did not understand. When he …saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth … And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods. And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field –1 Samuel 17:42-44.

Then David said …Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied. This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee … that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel –1 Samuel 17:45-46.

Notice then what David did. He killed the giant, cut off his head, and took his head back to Jerusalem. What do you think Eliab thought now? Here is the younger brother marching around the streets of Jerusalem with the head of the defeated giant! King Saul calls for David and he goes to see Saul, still holding the severed head.

Why was David not proud? Because he knew it was not he himself that did it. It was God who had done a marvelous work! He was simply testifying of the grace of God.

When we do a work on our own, we cannot boast of it because we did it. It would be pride, so we remain silent and call it humility, even if we desire others to see it. However, when it is a super-natural work of God, we now must boast of what God has done! We are called to this.

Is God working in your life? Are you confused as to whether it is you or God? Ask yourself a question, “Am I doing things that people who are not relying on God can still do?” If we are not doing anything differently than the world, then God is not working in our life. It is that simple. No one enjoys getting angry. I spent most of my childhood and teenage years going to anger management classes where counselors tried to teach us how to control our anger. The unregenerate heart can learn to hide anger, but only God can change the heart. I never heard a counselor teach us how to love people instead of getting angry with them, since it is impossible! It is only a work of the living God in one’s life, and in that work, we must boast! We testify of the outpouring of the grace of God in our lives. When someone believes it is pride, just like Eliab did, it’s because they only see the working of the Law, where all is done by man’s feeble attempts.

Let us look at an example to help us understand. If you decide to build a house, every day you put on your nail bag and get to work. It takes you time and energy, but finally the house is finished. You are standing in front of the newly constructed home with a friend. “Wow,” he states, “This house is beautiful! It looks perfectly built!”

Your cheeks blush a little and you begin to point out the flaws that you know, “No, it’s not perfect, you see that over there? I messed up on that gable…. And the siding over there… it’s not exactly straight.” We do this because we want to be humble! If we would say, “Yes, it is a beautiful house; I did a great job building it!” it would be prideful, right?

Now, what if you wanted to build a house and you realize you are not able to build it; you need God’s help. You pray for help then bam, the house is built! You never even put on your nail bag; the house miraculously appeared. God built it. Now how would the conversation go with your friend? Would you still point out all the flaws? NO! You would boast of its perfection, boldly proclaiming what the Lord had done.

When God does a work in our lives, it is not pride to tell people about it. It takes humility to say that we did not do it, but that God did! However, the devil wants us to quiet down and say it is humility like Eliab wanted David to do. We need men and women today that can boldly proclaim what God is doing in their lives!

Instead, it seems we have many defeated people that actually believe it is godly to talk down about ourselves, to act as if we are a defeated sinner trying to struggle through this earthly existence. “Rise up, Oh man of God! Be done with lesser things!”

I realize one could ask, “So, we should go around boasting about how righteous we are?” To this question, I will paint another picture. A poor criminal who has only known the city streets as home, steals and robs just to get by. He knows he is a bad person, yet he knows nothing else. One day God reveals himself to this man. In a dark alley he repents of his sin and gives his life to the Lord. God saves him, transforms him, converts him. He leaves that alley a new person! He has joy in his heart and peace in his soul!

What do you expect him to tell his friends? Um, the siding over there is not straight, the windows are too small….

NO, certainly not! Rather, he would say I’m perfect! God has done a great work, look at me! I’ve been saved by the power of God! By the blood of Jesus! All this as he skips down the road in the beauty of holiness.

Η υπερηφάνεια είναι κάτι με το οποίο πρέπει να παλέψει ο καθένας. Είναι κάτι που από τη φύση του τείνει να μπαίνει στη ζωή μας και να παραμένει. Όπως πολλά άλλα πράγματα, είναι πολύ παραπλανητική, επειδή γίνεται ευρέως αποδεκτή στον κόσμο όπου ζούμε. Οι άνθρωποι σήμερα είναι υπερήφανοι για την υπερηφάνειά τους. Οι Αμερικανοί είναι υπερήφανοι για τη χώρα τους, τις δουλειές τους, τα παιδιά τους, τους χλοοτάπητές τους, τις αθλητικές ομάδες τους, τα οχήματά τους, τις φιλοδοξίες τους, τους στόχους τους, την εμφάνισή τους, τους φίλους τους, τα σπίτια τους, και ο κατάλογος θα μπορούσε να συνεχιστεί. Αν το σκεφτούμε, ο σαρκικός άνθρωπος είναι υπερήφανος σχεδόν για οτιδήποτε. Οι άνθρωποι στέκονται και διακηρύσσουν ότι είναι υπερήφανοι και καυχιούνται για τα μεγάλα τους κατορθώματα. Κοιτάζουν κάτι που έκανε κάποιος και του λένε: «Θα έπρεπε να είσαι υπερήφανος για τον εαυτό σου!»

Υπάρχει ένα πρόβλημα· ο Θεός μισεί την υπερηφάνεια! Ο Θεός πράγματι αποστρέφεται τους υπερήφανους. Στους Ψαλμούς λέει ότι ο Θεός θα αποκόψει …τη γλώσσα που λαλεί υπερήφανα πράγματα –Ψαλμός 12:3. Και στον Ιώβ λέει ότι θα …δει κάθε υπερήφανο και θα τον ταπεινώσει [θα τον καταβάλει ή θα τον χαμηλώσει] –Ιώβ 40:11. Ο Ψαλμός 40:4 λέει ότι δεν θα επιδοκιμάσει τους υπερήφανους, και στον Ψαλμό 119: Επιτίμησες τους υπερήφανους, τους καταραμένους, που πλανώνται από τις εντολές σου –Ψαλμός 119:21. Στις Παροιμίες διαβάζουμε: Ο Κύριος θα καταστρέψει το σπίτι των υπερηφάνων… –Παροιμίες 15:25, και ότι Κάθε υπερήφανος στην καρδιά είναι βδέλυγμα στον Κύριο… –Παροιμίες 16:5. Στον Μαλαχία λέει ότι …έρχεται η ημέρα, που θα καίει σαν καμίνι· και όλοι οι υπερήφανοι… –Μαλαχίας 4:1. Τέλος, ο Ιάκωβος δηλώνει ότι …ο Θεός αντιτάσσεται στους υπερήφανους, αλλά δίνει χάρη στους ταπεινούς –Ιακώβου 4:6.

Όπως βλέπουμε, η Βίβλος είναι πολύ σαφής σχετικά με την υπερηφάνεια και τους υπερήφανους ανθρώπους. Δεν υπάρχει χώρος για υπερηφάνεια στην καρδιά ή στη ζωή μας. Τι κάνουμε λοιπόν γι’ αυτό; Είμαστε υπερήφανοι; Καυχιόμαστε όπως ο κόσμος;

Θα ήθελα να επιστήσω την προσοχή σε μια κρυφή μορφή υπερηφάνειας που μπορεί να εισχωρήσει στη ζωή μας, μερικές φορές χωρίς να το αντιληφθούμε. Θα την ονομάσουμε ψεύτικη ταπεινοφροσύνη. Αν έχουμε ψεύτικη ταπεινοφροσύνη, δεν είναι στην πραγματικότητα μια μορφή υπερηφάνειας;

Ας κοιτάξουμε πρώτα τον Νόμο και τη Χάρη. Όποιος βρίσκεται κάτω από τον νόμο δεν θέλει να κάνει αυτό που πρέπει να κάνει· το κάνει, αντίθετα, εξαιτίας του νόμου. Για παράδειγμα, ο νόμος λέει ότι δεν πρέπει να σκοτώνουμε, ωστόσο (σύμφωνα με τον νόμο) επιτρέπεται να θυμώνουμε. Κάποιος μπορεί να μισεί έναν άλλον και ακόμη και να θέλει να τον σκοτώσει, αλλά αν αντισταθεί στον πειρασμό να τον σκοτώσει, έχει πράγματι τηρήσει τον νόμο. Πολλοί άνθρωποι σήμερα που ισχυρίζονται ότι είναι χριστιανοί, στην πραγματικότητα βρίσκονται κάτω από τον νόμο. Κάνουν ό,τι κάνουν εξαιτίας κάποιου νόμου ή εντολής της εξουσίας τους. Αυτό φαίνεται καθαρά όταν οι άνθρωποι πιέζουν τα όρια του νόμου, κάνοντας το ελάχιστο που απαιτείται, αλλά εξακολουθώντας τεχνικά να τηρούν τον νόμο.

Το κάλυμμα της κεφαλής είναι καλό παράδειγμα. Μια γυναίκα που επιθυμεί να καλύπτει το κεφάλι της εξαιτίας όσων διδάσκει η Βίβλος, πράγματι θα το καλύπτει. Δεν χρειάζεται να της το υπενθυμίζουν ούτε να την επιπλήττουν επειδή το κάνει χωρίς πραγματική προθυμία. Από την άλλη, υπάρχουν χριστιανές που καλύπτουν το κεφάλι τους· ωστόσο, το ίδιο το κάλυμμα γίνεται όλο και μικρότερο και λιγότερο εμφανές. Μερικές το τοποθετούν ακόμη και εντελώς πίσω στο κεφάλι και το βάφουν στο ίδιο χρώμα με τα μαλλιά τους, προσπαθώντας να μην το προσέξει το ακάλυπτο κοινό. Αυτό φανερώνει ξεκάθαρα την καρδιά τους· απλώς συμμορφώνονται με τον νόμο.

Αυτός ο τρόπος σκέψης μπορεί να εφαρμοστεί σε πολλά πράγματα. Ένα ακόμη παράδειγμα είναι ο στολισμός. Η Βίβλος λέει ότι ο στολισμός δεν πρέπει να είναι εξωτερικός. Πολλοί χριστιανοί δεν στολίζονται με εντυπωσιακά, τραβηχτικά αντικείμενα, ωστόσο δεν υπάρχουν κανόνες σχετικά με τον στολισμό των σπιτιών, των οχημάτων και παρόμοιων πραγμάτων. Έτσι, ένας απλός, αστόλιστος άνθρωπος βγαίνει από το στολισμένο όχημά του και μπαίνει στο πολύ στολισμένο σπίτι του. Αυτό δείχνει ότι η καρδιά παραμένει δεσμευμένη στη νοοτροπία του νόμου.

Τώρα ας κοιτάξουμε τη χάρη. Είναι η δύναμη του Θεού στη ζωή ενός ανθρώπου. Κάνει τον άνθρωπο να αγαπά πραγματικά τους εχθρούς του και να κάνει καλό σε όσους του φέρονται άσχημα. Τον κάνει να αγαπά τον Θεό του με όλη του την καρδιά και να υπακούει στις εντολές του Θεού από βαθιά αγάπη γι’ Αυτόν. Ο νόμος δεν χρειάζεται πια, επειδή η καρδιά είναι νέα· επιθυμεί να ζει για τον Θεό. Όταν κάποιος σου κάνει κακό, δεν σκέφτεσαι να του το ανταποδώσεις. Στην πραγματικότητα, δεν θυμώνεις καν. Είσαι νέο δημιούργημα και, χάρη σε αυτή τη δύναμη —τη χάρη του Θεού— αγαπάς εκείνον που σε αδίκησε. Η συγχώρηση δεν είναι πρόβλημα· το να βοηθάς τους άλλους είναι κάτι φυσικό. Δεν ανήκεις στον εαυτό σου και επιθυμείς να γίνεις ό,τι καλύτερο μπορείς για τον Σωτήρα σου, που πέθανε για σένα.

Τι σχέση έχουν όλα αυτά με την υπερηφάνεια ή την ταπεινοφροσύνη;

Η Βίβλος λέει ότι …ο νόμος δόθηκε μέσω του Μωυσή, αλλά η χάρη και η αλήθεια ήρθαν μέσω του Ιησού Χριστού –Ιωάννης 1:17. Δεν χρειάζεται το Πνεύμα του Θεού στη ζωή μας για να υπακούσουμε στον νόμο — μπορούμε να το κάνουμε μόνοι μας. Επομένως, μπορούμε να γίνουμε υπερήφανοι κάνοντας πράγματα για τον Θεό επειδή τα κάναμε ΕΜΕΙΣ. Όταν δεν αφήσαμε τον θυμό μας να ξεσπάσει επειδή διαφωνούσαμε με έναν γείτονα, σχηματίζουμε καλή γνώμη για τον εαυτό μας και μπορεί να γίνουμε υπερήφανοι. Όταν όμως αγαπάμε πραγματικά τον γείτονά μας που έχει πρόβλημα μαζί μας, δεν μπορούμε να γίνουμε υπερήφανοι, γιατί αυτό ήταν χάρη· ήταν η δύναμη του Θεού που το προκάλεσε, όχι εμείς. Γι’ αυτό θαυμάζουμε τον Θεό και την άφθονη χάρη Του.

Θα ήταν ανόητο να καυχιέται κάποιος για κάτι που έκανε ξεκάθαρα ο Θεός! Αν ο Λάζαρος τριγυρνούσε καυχιέμενος ότι αναστήθηκε από τους νεκρούς, οι άνθρωποι θα αμφισβητούσαν τη λογική του και θα έλεγαν: «Δεν έκανες τίποτα! Ο Ιησούς τα έκανε όλα».

Δεν προσπαθώ να πω ότι ο χριστιανός δεν κάνει τίποτα. Όχι, πρέπει να υπακούμε ταπεινά στις εντολές του Θεού και να περπατάμε στους δρόμους Του. Ωστόσο, λέω ότι δεν μπορούμε να καυχιόμαστε για τον εαυτό μας, επειδή ο Θεός είναι εκείνος που μας δίνει τη δυνατότητα να υπακούμε στις εντολές Του.

Ας κοιτάξουμε τη γνωστή ιστορία του Δαβίδ και του Γολιάθ. Ο Δαβίδ πήγε στο στρατόπεδο για να μεταφέρει προμήθειες στους αδελφούς του που πολεμούσαν εκεί. Καθώς πλησίαζε, έμεινε έκπληκτος με αυτό που είδε: έναν μεγαλόσωμο άντρα να προκαλεί τον λαό του! Ο Δαβίδ φάνηκε κάπως σοκαρισμένος και αγανακτισμένος, καθώς ρώτησε: …ποιος είναι αυτός ο απερίτμητος Φιλισταίος, που αψηφά τα στρατεύματα του ζωντανού Θεού; –Α΄ Σαμουήλ 17:26.

Τι του λέει ο Ελιάβ, ο μεγαλύτερος αδελφός του Δαβίδ; «Ξέρω την υπερηφάνειά σου».

Ο Ελιάβ θεώρησε υπερήφανη τη στάση του Δαβίδ, και μπορούμε να καταλάβουμε γιατί. Ένα κοκκινομάλλικο παλικάρι, που έρχεται από τη βοσκή των προβάτων, αναρωτιέται γιατί κανείς δεν φροντίζει αυτόν τον μεγαλόσωμο άντρα. Ακούγεται κάπως παράξενο. Αλλά τι σκεφτόταν ο Δαβίδ; Σκεφτόταν μόνο τι μπορούσε να κάνει ο Θεός και, πιθανότατα, τι ήθελε να κάνει! Δεν σκέφτηκε ούτε για μια στιγμή ότι ο ίδιος θα μπορούσε να κάνει κάτι σε αυτή την κατάσταση.

Έπειτα τον φέρνουν μπροστά στον βασιλιά Σαούλ: Και ο Σαούλ είπε στον Δαβίδ: Δεν μπορείς να πας να πολεμήσεις εναντίον αυτού του Φιλισταίου, επειδή δεν είσαι παρά ένα νεαρό παλικάρι, ενώ εκείνος είναι πολεμιστής από τα νιάτα του –Α΄ Σαμουήλ 17:33.

Ο Δαβίδ απάντησε: …Ο δούλος σου έβοσκε τα πρόβατα του πατέρα του· και ήρθε ένα λιοντάρι και μια αρκούδα, και άρπαξε ένα αρνί από το κοπάδι· και βγήκα πίσω του, και το χτύπησα, και το έσωσα από το στόμα του· και όταν σηκώθηκε εναντίον μου, το έπιασα από τα γένια, και το χτύπησα, και το σκότωσα. Ο δούλος σου σκότωσε και το λιοντάρι και την αρκούδα· και αυτός ο απερίτμητος Φιλισταίος θα είναι σαν ένα από αυτά, επειδή αψήφησε τα στρατεύματα του ζωντανού Θεού –Α΄ Σαμουήλ 17:34-36.

Εδώ ο Δαβίδ έχει τεράστια αυτοπεποίθηση, αλλά γιατί; Ο Δαβίδ είπε ακόμη: Ο Κύριος που με έσωσε από τα νύχια του λιονταριού και από τα νύχια της αρκούδας, Αυτός θα με σώσει από το χέρι αυτού του Φιλισταίου… –Α΄ Σαμουήλ 17:37.

Είναι ξεκάθαρο ότι η αυτοπεποίθησή του οφείλεται στο ότι ο Κύριος πολεμά γι’ αυτόν. Ο Δαβίδ δεν ανησυχούσε που ήταν «ακόμα νέος» και δεν καταλάβαινε γιατί οι άνθρωποι τον αμφισβητούσαν. Σκεφτόταν μόνο τι επρόκειτο να κάνει ο Θεός! Ωστόσο, ο Ελιάβ είδε την αυτοπεποίθηση του Δαβίδ ως υπερηφάνεια. Ίσως ο Θεός να μην είχε εργαστεί στη ζωή του Ελιάβ. Ίσως να μη γνώριζε τη δύναμη του Θεού· γι’ αυτό, σε εκείνον έμοιαζε με ανόητη υπερηφάνεια.

Και ο Σαούλ έντυσε τον Δαβίδ με την πανοπλία του, και έβαλε στο κεφάλι του χάλκινη περικεφαλαία· επίσης, τον έντυσε με θώρακα. Και ο Δαβίδ ζώστηκε το σπαθί του πάνω από την πανοπλία του και δοκίμασε να περπατήσει· επειδή δεν είχε συνηθίσει την πανοπλία. Και ο Δαβίδ είπε στον Σαούλ: Δεν μπορώ να πάω με αυτά· επειδή δεν τα έχω δοκιμάσει. Και ο Δαβίδ τα έβγαλε από πάνω του –Α΄ Σαμουήλ 17:38-39.

Έτσι, ο Δαβίδ επέλεξε να μη φορέσει την πανοπλία· θα τον δυσκόλευε μόνο. Αντί γι’ αυτό, διάλεξε μερικές πέτρες και έτρεξε να πολεμήσει τον γίγαντα. Φυσικά, ούτε ο γίγαντας καταλάβαινε. Όταν …είδε τον Δαβίδ, τον περιφρόνησε, επειδή ήταν ακόμα νέος … Και ο Φιλισταίος είπε στον Δαβίδ: Είμαι εγώ σκύλος, ώστε να έρχεσαι εναντίον μου με ραβδιά; Και ο Φιλισταίος καταράστηκε τον Δαβίδ στους θεούς του. Και ο Φιλισταίος είπε στον Δαβίδ: Έλα σε μένα, και θα δώσω τη σάρκα σου στα πουλιά του ουρανού και στα θηρία του αγρού –Α΄ Σαμουήλ 17:42-44.

Τότε ο Δαβίδ είπε: …Εσύ έρχεσαι εναντίον μου με σπαθί, και με δόρυ, και με ασπίδα· εγώ όμως έρχομαι εναντίον σου στο όνομα του Κυρίου των στρατευμάτων, του Θεού των στρατευμάτων του Ισραήλ, τον οποίο εσύ αψήφησες. Αυτή την ημέρα ο Κύριος θα σε παραδώσει στο χέρι μου· και θα σε χτυπήσω … ώστε όλη η γη να γνωρίσει ότι υπάρχει Θεός στον Ισραήλ –Α΄ Σαμουήλ 17:45-46.

Προσέξτε τι έκανε στη συνέχεια ο Δαβίδ. Σκότωσε τον γίγαντα, του έκοψε το κεφάλι και πήρε το κεφάλι του πίσω στην Ιερουσαλήμ. Τι νομίζετε ότι σκεφτόταν τώρα ο Ελιάβ; Να ο μικρότερος αδελφός που παρελαύνει στους δρόμους της Ιερουσαλήμ κρατώντας το κεφάλι του νικημένου γίγαντα! Ο βασιλιάς Σαούλ καλεί τον Δαβίδ κι εκείνος πηγαίνει να δει τον Σαούλ, κρατώντας ακόμη το κομμένο κεφάλι.

Γιατί δεν ήταν υπερήφανος ο Δαβίδ; Επειδή ήξερε ότι δεν το έκανε ο ίδιος. Ο Θεός είχε κάνει ένα θαυμαστό έργο! Εκείνος απλώς μαρτυρούσε τη χάρη του Θεού.

Όταν κάνουμε ένα έργο μόνοι μας, δεν μπορούμε να καυχηθούμε γι’ αυτό, επειδή εμείς το κάναμε. Αυτό θα ήταν υπερηφάνεια, γι’ αυτό μένουμε σιωπηλοί και το αποκαλούμε ταπεινοφροσύνη, ακόμη κι αν θέλουμε να το δουν οι άλλοι. Όταν όμως πρόκειται για ένα υπερφυσικό έργο του Θεού, τώρα πρέπει να καυχηθούμε γι’ αυτό που έκανε ο Θεός! Είμαστε καλεσμένοι να το κάνουμε.

Εργάζεται ο Θεός στη ζωή σου; Έχεις μπερδευτεί ως προς το αν είναι έργο δικό σου ή του Θεού; Κάνε στον εαυτό σου την εξής ερώτηση: «Κάνω πράγματα που μπορούν να κάνουν και άνθρωποι οι οποίοι δεν στηρίζονται στον Θεό;» Αν δεν κάνουμε τίποτα διαφορετικό από τον κόσμο, τότε ο Θεός δεν εργάζεται στη ζωή μας. Είναι τόσο απλό. Σε κανέναν δεν αρέσει να θυμώνει. Πέρασα τα περισσότερα παιδικά και εφηβικά μου χρόνια πηγαίνοντας σε μαθήματα διαχείρισης θυμού, όπου σύμβουλοι προσπαθούσαν να μας διδάξουν πώς να ελέγχουμε τον θυμό μας. Η μη αναγεννημένη καρδιά μπορεί να μάθει να κρύβει τον θυμό, αλλά μόνο ο Θεός μπορεί να αλλάξει την καρδιά. Δεν άκουσα ποτέ κάποιον σύμβουλο να μας διδάσκει πώς να αγαπάμε τους ανθρώπους αντί να θυμώνουμε μαζί τους, αφού αυτό είναι αδύνατο! Είναι αποκλειστικά έργο του ζωντανού Θεού στη ζωή κάποιου, και γι’ αυτό το έργο πρέπει να καυχιόμαστε! Μαρτυρούμε την έκχυση της χάρης του Θεού στη ζωή μας. Όταν κάποιος πιστεύει ότι αυτό είναι υπερηφάνεια, όπως ακριβώς έκανε ο Ελιάβ, είναι επειδή βλέπει μόνο την εργασία του Νόμου, όπου όλα γίνονται με τις αδύναμες προσπάθειες του ανθρώπου.

Ας δούμε ένα παράδειγμα για να καταλάβουμε. Αν αποφασίσεις να χτίσεις ένα σπίτι, κάθε μέρα φοράς τη θήκη με τα καρφιά σου και πιάνεις δουλειά. Χρειάζεται χρόνος και κόπος, αλλά τελικά το σπίτι ολοκληρώνεται. Στέκεσαι μπροστά στο καινούργιο σπίτι με έναν φίλο. «Ουάου», λέει, «αυτό το σπίτι είναι πανέμορφο! Φαίνεται τέλεια χτισμένο!»

Τα μάγουλά σου κοκκινίζουν λίγο και αρχίζεις να επισημαίνεις τα ελαττώματα που γνωρίζεις: «Όχι, δεν είναι τέλειο· βλέπεις εκεί πέρα; Έκανα λάθος σε εκείνο το αέτωμα… Και η επένδυση εκεί πέρα… δεν είναι ακριβώς ίσια». Το κάνουμε αυτό επειδή θέλουμε να είμαστε ταπεινοί! Αν λέγαμε: «Ναι, είναι ένα όμορφο σπίτι· έκανα εξαιρετική δουλειά όταν το έχτισα!» θα ήταν υπερηφάνεια, έτσι δεν είναι;

Τώρα, τι θα γινόταν αν ήθελες να χτίσεις ένα σπίτι και συνειδητοποιούσες ότι δεν μπορείς να το χτίσεις· χρειάζεσαι τη βοήθεια του Θεού. Προσεύχεσαι για βοήθεια και ξαφνικά, μπαμ, το σπίτι χτίζεται! Δεν φόρεσες ποτέ καν τη θήκη με τα καρφιά σου· το σπίτι εμφανίστηκε θαυματουργικά. Το έχτισε ο Θεός. Τώρα, πώς θα εξελισσόταν η συζήτηση με τον φίλο σου; Θα εξακολουθούσες να επισημαίνεις όλα τα ελαττώματα; ΟΧΙ! Θα καυχιόσουν για την τελειότητά του, διακηρύσσοντας με τόλμη τι είχε κάνει ο Κύριος.

Όταν ο Θεός κάνει ένα έργο στη ζωή μας, δεν είναι υπερηφάνεια να το λέμε στους ανθρώπους. Χρειάζεται ταπεινοφροσύνη για να πούμε ότι δεν το κάναμε εμείς, αλλά ο Θεός! Ωστόσο, ο διάβολος θέλει να σωπάσουμε και να πούμε ότι πρόκειται για ταπεινοφροσύνη, όπως ήθελε ο Ελιάβ να κάνει ο Δαβίδ. Χρειαζόμαστε σήμερα άντρες και γυναίκες που μπορούν να διακηρύττουν με τόλμη τι κάνει ο Θεός στη ζωή τους!

Αντί γι’ αυτό, φαίνεται πως έχουμε πολλούς ηττημένους ανθρώπους που πιστεύουν πράγματι ότι είναι ευσεβές να μιλάμε υποτιμητικά για τον εαυτό μας, να συμπεριφερόμαστε σαν ηττημένοι αμαρτωλοί που αγωνίζονται να τα βγάλουν πέρα σε αυτή την επίγεια ύπαρξη. «Σήκω, άνθρωπε του Θεού! Άφησε πια τα κατώτερα πράγματα!»

Καταλαβαίνω ότι κάποιος θα μπορούσε να ρωτήσει: «Δηλαδή, πρέπει να τριγυρνάμε καυχιόμενοι για το πόσο δίκαιοι είμαστε;» Σε αυτό το ερώτημα θα δώσω ένα άλλο παράδειγμα. Ένας φτωχός εγκληματίας, που γνώρισε ως σπίτι του μόνο τους δρόμους της πόλης, κλέβει και ληστεύει για να τα βγάλει πέρα. Ξέρει ότι είναι κακός άνθρωπος, αλλά δεν ξέρει τίποτε άλλο. Μια μέρα ο Θεός αποκαλύπτεται σε αυτόν τον άνθρωπο. Σε ένα σκοτεινό σοκάκι μετανοεί για την αμαρτία του και παραδίδει τη ζωή του στον Κύριο. Ο Θεός τον σώζει, τον μεταμορφώνει, τον μεταστρέφει. Φεύγει από εκείνο το σοκάκι και είναι άλλος άνθρωπος! Έχει χαρά στην καρδιά του και ειρήνη στην ψυχή του!

Τι περιμένετε να πει στους φίλους του; Ε, η επένδυση εκεί πέρα δεν είναι ίσια, τα παράθυρα είναι πολύ μικρά….

ΟΧΙ, βέβαια και όχι! Αντίθετα, θα έλεγε: «Είμαι τέλειος! Ο Θεός έκανε μεγάλο έργο, κοιτάξτε με! Σώθηκα με τη δύναμη του Θεού! Με το αίμα του Ιησού!» Και όλα αυτά καθώς προχωρά χοροπηδώντας στον δρόμο, μέσα στην ομορφιά της αγιότητας.

Pride is something that everyone must deal with. It is something that naturally tends to come into our lives and stay. Like many other things, it is very deceitful, because it is commonly accepted by the world in which we live. People today are proud of being proud. Americans are proud of their country, their jobs, their children, their lawns, their sports teams, their vehicles, their ambitions, their goals, their looks, their friends, their homes, and the list could go on. If we think about it, the carnal man is proud of just about anything. People stand and proclaim they are proud and boast of their great accomplishments. People look at something someone has done and proclaim to the doer, “You should be proud of yourself!”

There is one problem; God hates pride! God actually despises the proud. In Psalms, it says that God will cut off …the tongue that speaketh proud things –Psalm 12:3. And in Job it says He will …behold every one that is proud, and abase [put down or make low] him –Job 40:11. Psalms 40:4 says He will not respect the proud and in Psalm 119: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments –Psalm 119:21. In Proverbs, we read that: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud… –Proverbs 15:25, and that Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD… –Proverbs 16:5. In Malachi, it says that …behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud… –Malachi 4:1. Finally, James states that …God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble –James 4:6.

As we can see, the Bible is very clear on pride, and the people who are proud. There is no room for pride in our hearts or lives. So, what do we do with this? Are we proud? Do we boast as the world does?

I would like to call attention to a hidden form of pride that can slip into our lives, sometimes unnoticed. We will call it false humility. If we have a false humility, would it not actually be a form of pride?

Let us look first at Law and Grace. Someone that is under the law does not desire to do what he must do, but rather, he does it because of the law. For example, the law states that we should not kill, yet (according to the law) we are allowed to be angry. Someone can hate another and even desire to kill him, but if they resist the temptation to kill, they have indeed kept the law. Many people today who claim to be Christians, are actually under the law. They do all that they do because of a law, or an order from their authority. We can see this clearly when people push the law, doing the least that is required, but still technically keeping the law.

The head covering is a good example. A woman who desires to cover her head because of what the Bible teaches, will indeed cover her head. She does not need to be reminded to do it or be admonished for doing it half-heartedly. On the other hand, there are Christians that cover their heads; however, the actual covering continues to get smaller, and less noticeable. Some even put it all the way on the back of the head and color it the same as their hair, trying to keep it from being noticed by the uncovered public. This clearly reveals the heart; they are simply complying with the law.

This type of thinking can go for many things. One more would be adornment. The bible says that the adornment should not be outward. Many Christians will not adorn themselves with flashy eye-catching things, however there are no standards about adorning homes, vehicles, and such like. So, a plain, unadorned person gets out of their adorned vehicle and walks into their very adorned home. This shows where the heart is—under the law.

Now let us look at grace. It is the power of God in the life of a human being. It causes one to actually love their enemies, to do good to those who mistreat them. It causes one to love their God with all their heart and obey God’s commands because of a passionate love for Him. The law is no longer needed because the heart is new; it desires to live for God. When someone does evil to you, you do not think about getting even. In fact, you do not even get angry. You are a new creature and because of this power—grace from God—you love him that has done you wrong. Forgiving is not a problem; helping others is natural. You are not your own and you desire to be all you can be for your Savior who died for you.

What does this have to do with pride or humility?

The Bible says that …the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ –John 1:17. It does not take God’s Spirit in our lives for us to obey the law—we can do that on our own. Therefore, we can become proud by doing things for God because WE did them. When we did not allow our anger to spew out when disagreeing with a neighbor, we think well of ourselves, and we can become proud. However, when we actually love our neighbor that has a problem with us, we cannot become proud because it was grace; it was the power of God that caused this, not ourselves. Therefore, we marvel at God and his abundant grace.

It would be foolish for someone to be proud of something that God clearly did! If Lazarus walked around boasting of himself for being raised from the dead, people would question his sanity, saying, “You did nothing! It was Jesus that did everything.”

I’m not trying to say that the Christian does nothing. No, we must humbly obey the commandments of God and walk in His ways. However, I am saying that we cannot boast in ourselves because it is God that enables us to obey His commandments.

Let us look at the popular story of David and Goliath. David went to the army to take provisions to his brothers who were fighting there. As he approached, he marveled at what he saw, a large man challenging his people! David seemed a bit shocked, and aggrieved as he asked, …who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God? –1 Samuel 17:26.

What does David’s oldest brother Eliab say to him? “I know thy pride.”

Eliab thought the attitude of David was prideful, and we can see why. A ruddy youth walks up from tending sheep and wonders why someone is not taking care of this large man. It sounds a bit off. But what was David thinking? He was only thinking about what God could, and most likely, wanted to do! He did not think for a moment that he himself could do anything in this situation.

He is then brought before King Saul: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth –1 Samuel 17:33.

David responded, … Thy servant kept his father’s sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him. Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God –1 Samuel 17:34-36.

David here is super confident, but why?! David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine… –1 Samuel 17:37.

Clearly his confidence is because the Lord is fighting for him. David was not concerned that he was “but a youth” and he did not understand why people questioned him. He was only thinking about what God was going to do! However, Eliab saw David’s confidence as pride. Possibly God had not worked in Eliab’s life. Maybe he did not know of the power of God; therefore, to him it looked like foolish pride.

And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail. And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him –1 Samuel 17:38-39.

So, David chose to not wear the armor; it would only have been a hindrance. Rather, he chose some stones then he ran out to fight the giant. Of course, the giant also did not understand. When he …saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth … And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods. And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field –1 Samuel 17:42-44.

Then David said …Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied. This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee … that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel –1 Samuel 17:45-46.

Notice then what David did. He killed the giant, cut off his head, and took his head back to Jerusalem. What do you think Eliab thought now? Here is the younger brother marching around the streets of Jerusalem with the head of the defeated giant! King Saul calls for David and he goes to see Saul, still holding the severed head.

Why was David not proud? Because he knew it was not he himself that did it. It was God who had done a marvelous work! He was simply testifying of the grace of God.

When we do a work on our own, we cannot boast of it because we did it. It would be pride, so we remain silent and call it humility, even if we desire others to see it. However, when it is a super-natural work of God, we now must boast of what God has done! We are called to this.

Is God working in your life? Are you confused as to whether it is you or God? Ask yourself a question, “Am I doing things that people who are not relying on God can still do?” If we are not doing anything differently than the world, then God is not working in our life. It is that simple. No one enjoys getting angry. I spent most of my childhood and teenage years going to anger management classes where counselors tried to teach us how to control our anger. The unregenerate heart can learn to hide anger, but only God can change the heart. I never heard a counselor teach us how to love people instead of getting angry with them, since it is impossible! It is only a work of the living God in one’s life, and in that work, we must boast! We testify of the outpouring of the grace of God in our lives. When someone believes it is pride, just like Eliab did, it’s because they only see the working of the Law, where all is done by man’s feeble attempts.

Let us look at an example to help us understand. If you decide to build a house, every day you put on your nail bag and get to work. It takes you time and energy, but finally the house is finished. You are standing in front of the newly constructed home with a friend. “Wow,” he states, “This house is beautiful! It looks perfectly built!”

Your cheeks blush a little and you begin to point out the flaws that you know, “No, it’s not perfect, you see that over there? I messed up on that gable…. And the siding over there… it’s not exactly straight.” We do this because we want to be humble! If we would say, “Yes, it is a beautiful house; I did a great job building it!” it would be prideful, right?

Now, what if you wanted to build a house and you realize you are not able to build it; you need God’s help. You pray for help then bam, the house is built! You never even put on your nail bag; the house miraculously appeared. God built it. Now how would the conversation go with your friend? Would you still point out all the flaws? NO! You would boast of its perfection, boldly proclaiming what the Lord had done.

When God does a work in our lives, it is not pride to tell people about it. It takes humility to say that we did not do it, but that God did! However, the devil wants us to quiet down and say it is humility like Eliab wanted David to do. We need men and women today that can boldly proclaim what God is doing in their lives!

Instead, it seems we have many defeated people that actually believe it is godly to talk down about ourselves, to act as if we are a defeated sinner trying to struggle through this earthly existence. “Rise up, Oh man of God! Be done with lesser things!”

I realize one could ask, “So, we should go around boasting about how righteous we are?” To this question, I will paint another picture. A poor criminal who has only known the city streets as home, steals and robs just to get by. He knows he is a bad person, yet he knows nothing else. One day God reveals himself to this man. In a dark alley he repents of his sin and gives his life to the Lord. God saves him, transforms him, converts him. He leaves that alley a new person! He has joy in his heart and peace in his soul!

What do you expect him to tell his friends? Um, the siding over there is not straight, the windows are too small….

NO, certainly not! Rather, he would say I’m perfect! God has done a great work, look at me! I’ve been saved by the power of God! By the blood of Jesus! All this as he skips down the road in the beauty of holiness.

Kiburi ni jambo ambalo kila mtu lazima akabiliane nalo. Ni jambo ambalo kwa kawaida huingia katika maisha yetu na kubaki. Kama mambo mengine mengi, kina udanganyifu mkubwa, kwa sababu kinakubaliwa sana na ulimwengu tunamoishi. Leo watu hujivunia kuwa na kiburi. Wamarekani hujivunia nchi yao, kazi zao, watoto wao, nyasi zao za uani, timu zao za michezo, magari yao, matarajio yao, malengo yao, sura zao, marafiki zao, nyumba zao, na orodha inaweza kuendelea. Tukitafakari, mtu wa mwili hujivunia karibu kila kitu. Watu husimama na kutangaza kwamba wanajivunia, na kujisifu kwa mafanikio yao makubwa. Watu hutazama jambo ambalo mtu fulani amefanya na kumwambia aliyelifanya, “Unapaswa kujivunia mwenyewe!”

Kuna tatizo moja; Mungu huchukia kiburi! Kwa kweli, Mungu huwadharau wenye kiburi. Katika Zaburi, inasema kwamba Mungu atakata …ulimi unaosema maneno ya kiburi –Zaburi 12:3. Na katika Ayubu inasema kwamba atawaangalia …wote wenye kiburi, na kuwashusha chini [kuwaweka chini au kuwafanya wawe chini] –Ayubu 40:11. Zaburi 40:4 inasema kwamba hatawaheshimu wenye kiburi na katika Zaburi 119: Umewakemea wenye kiburi waliolaaniwa, ambao hukosa amri zako –Zaburi 119:21. Katika Mithali, tunasoma kwamba: BWANA ataibomoa nyumba ya mwenye kiburi… –Mithali 15:25, na kwamba Kila mwenye moyo wa kiburi ni chukizo kwa BWANA… –Mithali 16:5. Katika Malaki, inasema kwamba …tazama, siku inakuja, iwakayo kama tanuru; na wote wenye kiburi… –Malaki 4:1. Mwishowe, Yakobo anasema kwamba …Mungu huwapinga wenye kiburi, bali huwapa neema wanyenyekevu –Yakobo 4:6.

Kama tunavyoona, Biblia iko wazi sana kuhusu kiburi na watu wenye kiburi. Hakuna nafasi ya kiburi mioyoni mwetu au katika maisha yetu. Basi, tufanye nini kuhusu jambo hili? Tuna kiburi? Je, tunajisifu kama ulimwengu ufanyavyo?

Ningependa kuelekeza fikira kwenye aina ya kiburi iliyojificha ambayo inaweza kuingia katika maisha yetu, nyakati nyingine bila kutambuliwa. Tutaiita unyenyekevu wa bandia. Ikiwa tuna unyenyekevu wa bandia, je, kwa kweli si aina ya kiburi?

Hebu kwanza tuangalie Sheria na Neema. Mtu aliye chini ya sheria hatamani kufanya anachopaswa kufanya; badala yake, anakifanya kwa sababu ya sheria. Kwa mfano, sheria inasema kwamba hatupaswi kuua, lakini (kwa mujibu wa sheria) tunaruhusiwa kukasirika. Mtu anaweza kumchukia mwingine na hata kutamani kumuua, lakini akizuia kishawishi cha kuua, kwa kweli ameitii sheria. Watu wengi leo wanaodai kuwa Wakristo, kwa kweli wako chini ya sheria. Hufanya kila wanachofanya kwa sababu ya sheria, au amri kutoka kwa mwenye mamlaka yao. Tunaweza kuona jambo hili wazi watu wanaposisitiza sheria, wakifanya kiwango cha chini kabisa kinachotakiwa, lakini bado wakitii sheria kitaalamu.

Kufunika kichwa ni mfano mzuri. Mwanamke anayetaka kufunika kichwa chake kwa sababu ya kile ambacho Biblia hufundisha, hakika atakifunika. Hahitaji kukumbushwa kufanya hivyo wala kukaripiwa kwa kufanya hivyo bila moyo. Kwa upande mwingine, kuna Wakristo wanaofunika vichwa vyao; hata hivyo, kifuniko chenyewe huendelea kuwa kidogo zaidi, na kutotambulika kwa urahisi. Wengine hata hukivaa nyuma kabisa ya kichwa na kukipaka rangi inayofanana na nywele zao, wakijaribu kuzuia watu wasiokifunika wasikitambue. Jambo hili linafunua wazi kilicho moyoni; wanatii tu sheria.

Aina hii ya fikra inaweza kutumika katika mambo mengi. Jambo lingine ni mapambo. Biblia inasema kwamba mapambo hayapaswi kuwa ya nje. Wakristo wengi hawatajipamba kwa vitu vya kung’aa vinavyovuta macho, lakini hakuna viwango kuhusu kupamba nyumba, magari, na vitu vingine kama hivyo. Hivyo, mtu asiyejipamba na aliyevaa mavazi ya kawaida hushuka kutoka kwenye gari lake lililopambwa na kuingia katika nyumba yake iliyopambwa sana. Hili linaonyesha moyo uko wapi—chini ya sheria.

Sasa hebu tuangalie neema. Ni nguvu ya Mungu katika maisha ya mwanadamu. Humfanya mtu awapende kwa kweli adui zake, na kuwatendea mema wale wanaomtendea vibaya. Humfanya mtu ampende Mungu wake kwa moyo wake wote na kuzitii amri za Mungu kwa sababu ya upendo wenye shauku kwake. Sheria haihitajiki tena kwa sababu moyo ni mpya; unatamani kuishi kwa ajili ya Mungu. Mtu anapokutendea uovu, hufikirii kulipiza kisasi. Kwa kweli, hata hukasiriki. Wewe ni kiumbe kipya na kwa sababu ya nguvu hii—neema kutoka kwa Mungu—unampenda aliyekukosea. Kusamehe si tatizo; kuwasaidia wengine ni jambo la kawaida. Wewe si wako mwenyewe na unatamani kuwa kila uwezavyo kwa ajili ya Mwokozi wako aliyekufa kwa ajili yako.

Hili lina uhusiano gani na kiburi au unyenyekevu?

Biblia inasema kwamba …sheria ilitolewa na Musa, bali neema na kweli zilikuja kwa Yesu Kristo –Yohana 1:17. Haihitaji Roho wa Mungu maishani mwetu ili tutii sheria—tunaweza kufanya hivyo kwa nguvu zetu wenyewe. Kwa hiyo, tunaweza kuwa na kiburi kwa kufanya mambo kwa ajili ya Mungu kwa sababu NI SISI tuliyafanya. Tulipozuia hasira yetu isilipuke tulipokosana na jirani, tunajiona vizuri, na tunaweza kuwa na kiburi. Hata hivyo, tunapompenda kwa kweli jirani yetu aliye na tatizo nasi, hatuwezi kuwa na kiburi kwa sababu ilikuwa neema; ilikuwa nguvu ya Mungu iliyosababisha jambo hilo, si sisi wenyewe. Kwa hiyo, tunastaajabia Mungu na neema yake tele.

Itakuwa upumbavu kwa mtu kujivunia jambo ambalo kwa hakika Mungu ndiye alilofanya! Kama Lazaro angezunguka akijisifu kwa kufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, watu wangetilia shaka akili yake, wakisema, “Wewe hukufanya lolote! Yesu ndiye aliyefanya kila kitu.”

Sijaribu kusema kwamba Mkristo hafanyi chochote. La, tunapaswa kuzitii amri za Mungu kwa unyenyekevu na kutembea katika njia zake. Hata hivyo, nasema kwamba hatuwezi kujisifu kwa sababu ni Mungu anayetuwezesha kutii amri zake.

Hebu tuangalie hadithi maarufu ya Daudi na Goliathi. Daudi alienda kambini kwa jeshi ili kuwapelekea chakula ndugu zake waliokuwa wakipigana huko. Alipokaribia, alishangazwa na alichokiona, mtu mkubwa akiwapa changamoto watu wake! Daudi alionekana kushangaa kidogo na kusikitishwa alipouliza, …huyu Mfilisti asiyetahiriwa ni nani, hata ayapinge majeshi ya Mungu aliye hai? –1 Samweli 17:26.

Eliabu, ndugu mkubwa wa Daudi, anamwambia nini? “Najua kiburi chako.”

Eliabu alidhani mtazamo wa Daudi ulikuwa wa kiburi, na tunaweza kuona kwa nini. Kijana mwenye sura nyekundu anakuja kutoka kuchunga kondoo na kujiuliza kwa nini hakuna mtu anayeshughulika na huyu mtu mkubwa. Inaonekana ajabu kidogo. Lakini Daudi alikuwa akifikiria nini? Alikuwa akifikiria tu kile ambacho Mungu angeweza, na yaelekea alitaka, kufanya! Hakufikiri hata kwa muda kwamba yeye mwenyewe angeweza kufanya lolote katika hali hii.

Kisha anapelekwa mbele ya Mfalme Sauli: Sauli akamwambia Daudi, Huwezi kumwendea huyo Mfilisti kupigana naye: kwa maana wewe u kijana tu, naye ni mtu wa vita tangu ujana wake –1 Samweli 17:33.

Daudi akajibu, … Mtumishi wako alikuwa akichunga kondoo za baba yake; akaja simba na dubu, akachukua mwana-kondoo katika kundi; nami nikamfuata, nikampiga, nikamwokoa kutoka kinywani mwake; naye alipojiinua juu yangu, nikamshika kwa ndevu zake, nikampiga, nikamuua. Mtumishi wako amewaua simba na dubu wote wawili; na huyo Mfilisti asiyetahiriwa atakuwa kama mmoja wao, kwa kuwa ameyatukana majeshi ya Mungu aliye hai –1 Samweli 17:34-36.

Hapa Daudi ana uhakika mkubwa sana, lakini kwa nini?! Tena Daudi akasema, BWANA aliyeniokoa na makucha ya simba na makucha ya dubu, ndiye atakayeniokoa na mkono wa Mfilisti huyu… –1 Samweli 17:37.

Ni wazi kwamba uhakika wake unatokana na kuwa Bwana anampigania. Daudi hakuhangaishwa na kuwa alikuwa “kijana tu” na hakuelewa kwa nini watu walimtilia shaka. Alikuwa akifikiria tu kile ambacho Mungu angefanya! Hata hivyo, Eliabu aliuona uhakika wa Daudi kuwa kiburi. Labda Mungu hakuwa amefanya kazi katika maisha ya Eliabu. Huenda hakujua nguvu za Mungu; kwa hiyo, kwake jambo hilo lilionekana kuwa kiburi cha kipumbavu.

Sauli akamvisha Daudi mavazi yake ya vita, akamvika chapeo ya shaba kichwani; akamvika pia koti la chuma. Daudi akajifunga upanga wake juu ya mavazi yake, akajaribu kwenda; kwa maana hakuwa ameyazoea. Daudi akamwambia Sauli, Siwezi kwenda navyo; kwa maana sijavizoea. Basi Daudi akavivua –1 Samweli 17:38-39.

Kwa hiyo, Daudi alichagua kutovaa mavazi ya vita; yangekuwa kizuizi tu. Badala yake, alichagua mawe machache kisha akakimbia kwenda kupigana na jitu hilo. Bila shaka, jitu hilo pia halikuelewa. Alipo…mwona Daudi, akamdharau; maana alikuwa kijana tu … Mfilisti akamwambia Daudi, Je, mimi ni mbwa, hata uje kwangu na fimbo? Mfilisti akamlaani Daudi kwa miungu yake. Mfilisti akamwambia Daudi, Njoo kwangu, nami nitaitoa nyama yako kwa ndege wa angani na wanyama wa mwituni –1 Samweli 17:42-44.

Kisha Daudi akasema …Wewe unanijia kwa upanga, na kwa mkuki, na kwa ngao; bali mimi nakujia kwa jina la BWANA wa majeshi, Mungu wa majeshi ya Israeli, uliyetukana. Leo BWANA atakutia mkononi mwangu; nami nitakupiga … ili dunia yote ijue ya kuwa kuna Mungu katika Israeli –1 Samweli 17:45-46.

Ona basi alichofanya Daudi. Alimuua jitu hilo, akalikata kichwa, na kukipeleka kichwa chake Yerusalemu. Unadhani Eliabu alifikiria nini sasa? Huyu hapa ndugu mdogo akitembea katika mitaa ya Yerusalemu akiwa na kichwa cha jitu lililoshindwa! Mfalme Sauli anamwita Daudi, naye anakwenda kumwona Sauli, akiwa bado ameshika kichwa kilichokatwa.

Kwa nini Daudi hakuwa na kiburi? Kwa sababu alijua kwamba si yeye mwenyewe aliyefanya jambo hilo. Mungu ndiye aliyekuwa ametenda kazi ya ajabu! Alikuwa akishuhudia tu neema ya Mungu.

Tunapofanya kazi kwa nguvu zetu wenyewe, hatuwezi kujisifu kwa kazi hiyo, kwa kuwa sisi wenyewe ndio tuliifanya. Huo ungekuwa kiburi, kwa hiyo tunakaa kimya na kuita unyenyekevu, hata kama tunatamani wengine waione. Hata hivyo, kazi inapokuwa ya Mungu isiyo ya kawaida, sasa lazima tujisifu kwa kile ambacho Mungu amefanya! Tumeitwa kufanya hivyo.

Mungu anatenda kazi katika maisha yako? Je, umechanganyikiwa kama ni wewe au Mungu? Jiulize swali, “Je, ninafanya mambo ambayo watu wasiomtegemea Mungu bado wanaweza kufanya?” Ikiwa hatufanyi chochote tofauti na ulimwengu, basi Mungu hatendi kazi katika maisha yetu. Ni rahisi hivyo. Hakuna anayefurahia kukasirika. Nilikuwa nikihudhuria madarasa ya kudhibiti hasira katika sehemu kubwa ya utoto wangu na miaka yangu ya ujana, ambako washauri walijaribu kutufundisha jinsi ya kudhibiti hasira yetu. Moyo ambao haujazaliwa upya unaweza kujifunza kuficha hasira, lakini Mungu pekee ndiye awezaye kuubadilisha moyo. Sijawahi kumsikia mshauri akitufundisha jinsi ya kuwapenda watu badala ya kuwakasirikia, kwa kuwa hilo haliwezekani! Ni kazi ya Mungu aliye hai pekee katika maisha ya mtu, na katika kazi hiyo, lazima tujisifu! Tunashuhudia kumiminwa kwa neema ya Mungu katika maisha yetu. Mtu anapoamini kuwa huo ni kiburi, kama Eliabu alivyofanya, ni kwa sababu anaona tu utendaji wa Sheria, ambapo yote hufanywa na jitihada dhaifu za mwanadamu.

Hebu tuangalie mfano utakaotusaidia kuelewa. Ukiamua kujenga nyumba, kila siku unavaa mfuko wako wa misumari na kuanza kazi. Inakuchukua muda na nguvu, lakini hatimaye nyumba inakamilika. Umesimama mbele ya nyumba iliyojengwa hivi karibuni pamoja na rafiki yako. “Lo,” asema, “Nyumba hii ni nzuri! Inaonekana imejengwa kikamilifu!”

Mashavu yako yanakuwa mekundu kidogo na unaanza kutaja kasoro unazozijua, “Hapana, si kamili, unaona pale? Niliharibu sehemu ile ya paa…. Na vibao vya kufunika ukuta pale… haviko sawasawa kabisa.” Tunafanya hivi kwa sababu tunataka kuwa wanyenyekevu! Tukisema, “Ndiyo, ni nyumba nzuri; nimefanya kazi nzuri kuijenga!” hilo lingekuwa la kiburi, sivyo?

Sasa, je, ikiwa ulitaka kujenga nyumba lakini ukatambua kwamba huwezi kuijenga; unahitaji msaada wa Mungu. Unaomba msaada kisha pa! Nyumba imejengwa! Hujavaa hata mfuko wako wa misumari; nyumba imetokea kimiujiza. Mungu ndiye aliyeijenga. Mazungumzo yako na rafiki yako yangekuwaje sasa? Bado ungetaja kasoro zote? LA! Ungejisifu kwa ukamilifu wake, ukitangaza kwa ujasiri kile ambacho Bwana alikuwa amefanya.

Mungu anapotenda kazi katika maisha yetu, si kiburi kuwaambia watu kuhusu jambo hilo. Inahitaji unyenyekevu kusema kwamba si sisi tuliofanya, bali Mungu ndiye aliyefanya! Hata hivyo, ibilisi anataka tunyamaze na kusema huo ni unyenyekevu, kama Eliabu alivyotaka Daudi afanye. Leo tunahitaji wanaume na wanawake wanaoweza kutangaza kwa ujasiri kile ambacho Mungu anatenda katika maisha yao!

Badala yake, inaonekana tuna watu wengi waliokata tamaa ambao kwa kweli wanaamini kuwa ni jambo la kumcha Mungu kujisema vibaya, na kutenda kana kwamba sisi ni wenye dhambi walioshindwa wanaojaribu kujikakamua katika maisha haya ya duniani. “Inuka, Ee mtu wa Mungu! Acha mambo yasiyo na maana!”

Ninatambua kwamba mtu anaweza kuuliza, “Basi, twende tukijisifu jinsi tulivyo wenye haki?” Kwa swali hili, nitatoa mfano mwingine. Mhalifu maskini ambaye ameyajua tu mitaa ya jiji kuwa nyumbani kwake, huiba na kupora ili tu aendelee kuishi. Anajua kuwa yeye ni mtu mbaya, lakini hajui jambo jingine. Siku moja Mungu anajifunua kwa mtu huyu. Katika kichochoro cheusi anatubu dhambi yake na kuyatoa maisha yake kwa Bwana. Mungu anamwokoa, anamgeuza, anamfanya ageuke. Anaondoka katika kichochoro hicho akiwa mtu mpya! Ana furaha moyoni mwake na amani rohoni mwake!

Unatarajia awaambie nini marafiki zake? Ehm, vibao vya kufunika ukuta pale haviko sawa, madirisha ni madogo mno….

LA, hakika sivyo! Badala yake, angesema, Mimi ni mkamilifu! Mungu ametenda kazi kubwa, nitazameni! Nimeokolewa kwa nguvu za Mungu! Kwa damu ya Yesu! Haya yote huku akirukaruka barabarani katika uzuri wa utakatifu.

The storm was dark and threatening,
Dark clouds billowed o’er head.
Lightning flashed around me,
Fears gripped and filled me with dread.

Thunder rolled out its forebodings.
My heart felt heavy and numb.
All around the storm was raging,
The turmoil inside struck me dumb.

Not only was the danger around me,
But just as real was the peril within.
I trembled as I looked at the future,
Not knowing how next to begin.

What lay behind the fog?
The wind whistled in my ears.
Suggesting questions, tripping my feet,
And ladening me down with fears.

This storm had removed all signs of the path,
That one time I had thought I could see.
Now, all the familiar was gone to my eyes,
Each step taken hesitatingly.

At the end of myself, I cried out in fear...
"Lord, come unto me! Tarry not, oh my King!"
Silence reigned heavy, I felt all alone,
Only to hope did I cling.

Then a still, but strong voice spoke in my ear,
"My precious child, look up."
Why such a request? When engulfed as I was,
In the fog that refused to break up.

Still in hope, I lifted my eyes,
Trembling at the dark clouds around.
Yet as I looked, I saw something more,
A treasure in the sky there was found.

Amidst all the dark and threatening clouds,
There it was! A cleft of light!
A rainbow shone through, of loveliest hue,
A beacon amidst this dark night.

"My child, fear not, you were never alone.
Not for a second could I leave your side.
Though the path is obscure, and there is much to endure,
Do not doubt that in Me you can hide."

"Yes, for now, you walk amidst trials,
Fears threaten both inside and out.
You wonder and question what is next to be done,
Dangers seem to laugh and flout."

"But here I have placed My rainbow,
That amidst all the darkness and fear,
You can see that My promise is certain.
I will never forsake, but always be near."

"If you keep your eyes on this promise,
My light will guide your way.
The fears and dangers surrounding,
Will then be held at bay."

"This promise can also open to you,
The secrets that are hid 'midst the storm.
For My strength and power are manifest,
When these to My will conform."

"So, My child, gaze long at the rainbow.
Ponder the message it brings.
Though all around you is angry and wild,
Remember the promise that it sings."

~by Adrianna Fanton

A tempestade era escura e ameaçadora,
Nuvens escuras se acumulavam sobre mim.
Relâmpagos brilhavam ao meu redor,
O medo me dominava e me enchia de pavor.

O trovão anunciava maus presságios.
Meu coração parecia pesado e entorpecido.
Ao redor, a tempestade rugia,
A agitação dentro de mim me deixou sem palavras.

O perigo não estava apenas ao meu redor,
O risco dentro de mim era igualmente real.
Tremi ao olhar para o futuro,
Sem saber como recomeçar.

O que havia além da névoa?
O vento assobiava em meus ouvidos.
Sugerindo perguntas, fazendo-me tropeçar,
E me sobrecarregando de medos.

Esta tempestade apagou todos os sinais do caminho,
Que certa vez pensei conseguir enxergar.
Agora, tudo o que me era familiar desaparecera,
E eu avançava a cada passo, hesitante.

No limite das minhas forças, clamei com medo...
"Senhor, vem a mim! Não demores, ó meu Rei!"
O silêncio pesava, senti-me totalmente só,
E me agarrei apenas à esperança.

Então, uma voz suave, mas firme, falou ao meu ouvido,
"Minha preciosa criança, olha para cima."
Por que esse pedido? Quando eu estava tão envolvida
Na névoa que se recusava a se dissipar.

Ainda com esperança, ergui os olhos,
Tremendo diante das nuvens escuras ao redor.
Mas, ao olhar, vi algo mais,
Um tesouro que se encontrava no céu.

Em meio a todas aquelas nuvens escuras e ameaçadoras,
Lá estava! Uma fresta de luz!
Um arco-íris brilhava, de tonalidade belíssima,
Um farol em meio àquela noite escura.

"Minha criança, não temas, nunca estiveste só.
Nem por um segundo deixei de estar ao teu lado.
Embora o caminho seja obscuro e haja muito a suportar,
Não duvides de que podes encontrar refúgio em mim."

"Sim, por enquanto, caminhas em meio a provações,
Os medos ameaçam por dentro e por fora.
Perguntas e te questionas sobre o que fazer em seguida,
Os perigos parecem rir e zombar."

"Mas foi aqui que coloquei o meu arco-íris,
Para que, em meio a toda a escuridão e ao medo,
Possas ver que a minha promessa é certa.
Nunca te abandonarei, mas estarei sempre por perto."

"Se mantiveres os olhos nesta promessa,
A minha luz guiará o teu caminho.
Os medos e perigos ao teu redor
Serão então mantidos à distância."

"Esta promessa também pode revelar-te
Os segredos ocultos em meio à tempestade.
Pois o meu poder e a minha força se manifestam
Quando estes se conformam à minha vontade."

"Portanto, minha criança, contempla longamente o arco-íris.
Pondera a mensagem que ele traz.
Embora tudo ao teu redor esteja revolto e furioso,
Lembra-te da promessa que ele anuncia."

~por Adrianna Fanton
